source: built-in imagegen native PNG retained; transparent background enabled
promptTemplate: Create one isolated full-body 2D game sprite for the named enemy in a persistent guarded counter stance. The named enemy idle is the exact character identity authority: preserve species/body plan, colors, face, equipment, and costume. The approved Hound counter is pose/rendering guidance only, not anatomy. Show stable grounded weight and visible planted feet/paws, weapon or forelimbs poised to intercept then answer, front three-quarter view slightly screen-left. Held stance with no impact, action trail, sparks, projectile, motion blur, debris, floor, shadow, text, or background. Full silhouette, painterly matte style, restrained highlights, true transparent alpha, clean edges.
styleReference: stitchedHound-counter-v2-idle343-512.png, pose guidance only; each enemy current idle is identity authority
normalizer: Sharp alpha >2 crop; Lanczos3 resize; centered on 512x512 transparent canvas; painted foot y=479; counters use target enemy idle painted height, except accepted explicit add-on exceptions recorded per item
